barcode.title: Barcode labels
barcode.intro: Give every product a barcode, then print labels to stick on them. Scanning at the POS adds the item instantly. Products without a manufacturer barcode get an in-store EAN-13 (starting with 20).
barcode.missing: {n} product has no barcode yet. | {n} products have no barcode yet.
barcode.pickedWithoutCode: {n} selected product has no barcode and will be skipped. | {n} selected products have no barcode and will be skipped.
